metadata.question: Did the air temperature reach over 50 degrees Celsius at the Furnace Creek Visitor's Center on June 30, 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use ERA5-Land hourly 2-metre temperature reanalysis, subset to a 1-day window around 30 Jun 2013 over the Furnace Creek Visitor Center (Death Valley), and extract the maximum temperature reached on that day. 2. Masking strategy: ERA5-Land is a reanalysis product and requires no cloud mask. 3. Logic: If max temperature is None/NaN or outside physically plausible range (-50,70 °C) → C3. Otherwise, if max temp > 50 °C → A, else → B. import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1) Geometry & Time pt = ee.Geometry.Point(-116.875, 36.462) # Furnace Creek VC date = '2013-06-30' # 2) ERA5-Land hourly 2-metre temperature (Kelvin) ic = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') \ .filterDate(date, date).select('temperature_2m') # 2b) Check collection if ic.size().getInfo() == 0: print('No ERA5-Land data for 2013-06-30.') print('C1') else: # 3) Daily max temp (K) tmax_img = ic.max() max_k = tmax_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('temperature_2m').getInfo() # 3b) Null check if max_k is None: print('ERA5-Land returned None') print('C3') else: max_c = max_k - 273.15 print(f'ERA5-Land max 2m temperature: {max_c:.1f} °C') print(f'Pixels sampled: 1') # 4) Validate range if abs(max_c) > 150: print('C3') elif max_c > 50.0: print('A') else: print('B')

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1) Geometry & Time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point(-116.875, 36.462)  # Furnace Creek VC
date = '2013-06-30'

# 2) ERA5-Land hourly 2-metre temperature (Kelvin)
ic = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') \
        .filterDate(date, date).select('temperature_2m')

# 2b) Check collection
if ic.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print('No ERA5-Land data for 2013-06-30.')
    print('<answer>C1</answer>')
else:
    # 3) Daily max temp (K)
    tmax_img = ic.max()
    max_k = tmax_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('temperature_2m').getInfo()

    # 3b) Null check
    if max_k is None:
        print('ERA5-Land returned None')
        print('<answer>C3</answer>')
    else:
        max_c = max_k - 273.15
        print(f'ERA5-Land max 2m temperature: {max_c:.1f} °C')
        print(f'Pixels sampled: 1')

        # 4) Validate range
        if abs(max_c) > 150:
            print('<answer>C3</answer>')
        elif max_c > 50.0:
            print('<answer>A</answer>')
        else:
            print('<answer>B</answer>')
